answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the trellis. What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
